description: Compliance under Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules 2011 and Drugs and Cosmetics Rules (Part XV).

requirements.title: Generic Name of Cosmetic Product
requirements.description: Clear statement of the generic identity and nature of the cosmetic (e.g., Shampoo, Face Cream, Moisturiser).
requirements.recommendation_template: Ensure the cosmetic generic name is visible and prominent on the Principal Display Panel.

requirements.title: Manufacturer Name & Address
requirements.description: Name and principal postal address of the manufacturer or packer must be declared.
requirements.recommendation_template: State the complete manufacturer or packer postal address on the label.

requirements.title: Date of Manufacture
requirements.description: Month and year of manufacture must be indicated on the cosmetic product.
requirements.recommendation_template: Indicate MFD Date (MM/YYYY) clearly on the label.

requirements.title: Expiry / Best Before Date
requirements.description: Date of expiry or 'Best Before' / 'Use Before' statement must be declared.
requirements.recommendation_template: Print 'Best before XX months from mfg' or an explicit expiry date on the label.

requirements.title: Net Content (ml / g)
requirements.description: Net weight (g) or volume (ml) in standard SI units must be declared.
requirements.recommendation_template: Verify net volume or weight in standard metric units (ml, g) on the label.

requirements.title: Maximum Retail Price — MRP (Incl. of all taxes)
requirements.description: MRP inclusive of all taxes must be printed on the cosmetic label.
requirements.recommendation_template: Print MRP with explicit tax inclusion notice on the label.

requirements.title: Customer Service / Consumer Care Information
requirements.description: Consumer helpline number, contact email, and postal address for grievances.
requirements.recommendation_template: Ensure contact number and email for consumer grievances are printed on the label.
